naos.designBasis: Approximate design target from the doctor's reference image; not an archaeological measurement.

dimensionDefinitions.bodyWidth: Maximum structural shell width, excluding both platform steps and projecting surface/cornice details.
dimensionDefinitions.bodyHeight: Vertical distance from the top of the platform (body bottom) to the top of the roof.
dimensionDefinitions.bodyDepth: Maximum structural shell depth, excluding both platform steps and projecting surface/cornice details.
dimensionDefinitions.platformHeight: Vertical distance from the sanctuary floor to the body bottom; equal to both platform-step heights combined.
dimensionDefinitions.overallHeight: Vertical distance from the sanctuary floor to the top of the roof; platformHeight plus bodyHeight.
